The 20261028 migrations were applied with the same versions on 2026-10-28; the earlier tail resolves through connector-generated migration aliases. 20261028160000_optional_task_output was applied to production on 2026-10-28 in one transaction and recorded with the same version. 20261029120000_pm_company_handover was applied to production on 2026-10-29 in one transaction and recorded with the same version.

changeSummary.20261028120000_pm_no_hod_assignment_fall: Project Managers may assign Staff directly when the task department has no active HOD; HOD-first routing is unchanged elsewhere. Entity write policies point at the current mutator instead of the renamed legacy function.
changeSummary.20261028130000_service_command_guard_dir: The service command entity-type guard checks only the command's own writes, not rows maintained by progress triggers, and workflow generation may record its task ids on its deliverable.
changeSummary.20261028140000_task_stage_guard_correcti: The responsible PM can complete a Waiting Approval task whose approval mode is none; Staff can create tasks that start in Pending; HODs are no longer limited to the ordinary Staff status action list.
changeSummary.20261028150000_hod_patch_empty_defaults: HOD saves are no longer rejected when the app fills absent fields with defaults or omits the server-kept accountableLeadId/reviewCover; real changes to restricted fields stay denied.
changeSummary.20261028160000_optional_task_output: Output is optional when submitting any task, including deliverable-linked work; a supplied output link must still be a valid https URL without credentials.
changeSummary.20261029120000_pm_company_handover: A Project Manager who owns a company may hand it to another non-admin Project Manager; Boss Koo can still assign any owner. Both the company guard trigger and the service command accept the handover.
